name: signature-file
description: An identity whose signature is a text file (attach_signature and sig_file; the file is seeded in the profile, sig_on_reply and sig_on_fwd are on). The signature is added after the separator line to a new draft (plain text, and HTML in a pre block of class moz-signature), to a reply draft after the reply and the quote (plain and HTML) and to a forward draft after the forwarded message. saveDraft with draftId on a reply draft that already carries the signature replaces only the typed text and keeps the quote and the signature. Not covered: an HTML or an image signature file, a signature on a message of a plain-text identity that composes HTML. Nothing is sent.
